items.title: Travis Etienne: Chance to return in Week 10
items.text:
Head coach Kellen Moore said Wednesday that the Saints will wait until the end of the week to make a decision whether or not to activate Etienne from injured reserve, Mike Triplett of NewOrleans.Football reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
